summary.name: Igly
summary.one_liner: Igly is an AI marketing agent for small businesses that generates product photos, ads and UGC-style video ads from a description of what you sell, with edits made by asking.
keywords: create video ads without a creator
use_cases: Make product photos without a studio
Create UGC-style video ads for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Build Amazon and Shopify listing images from one photo
Remove or replace backgrounds on product shots
Edit images by describing changes in chat
summary.what_it_does: Igly is an AI image and video generator with a workspace built around an agent. You describe what you sell, and the agent plans steps, runs the tools and places results on an infinite canvas where you can make further edits by asking. Its Seller Studio turns one product photo into white-background listing images, lifestyle scenes and Amazon A+ content sized for Amazon and Shopify. UGC Studio lets you pick an AI creator, add a product and brief, and renders a talking video with captions. Video generation supports models such as Kling 3 Turbo, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0, with optional start and end frames. Image and video models share one credit balance.
notable: Agent that plans steps and lays results on a canvas, editable by asking
Seller Studio builds Amazon and Shopify listing images from one product photo
UGC Studio generates AI creator talking-head video ads with captions
Failed runs refunded automatically; outputs usable commercially without watermark
caveats: Free plan balance tops up to 20 credits daily; 100 starting credits for new accounts, with paid top-ups beyond that
iPhone and Android apps are described as coming later; mobile use is via phone browser for now
